visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with blonde hair tied back, wearing a floral patterned dress and a black knitted shawl, walks away from the camera on a sidewalk. She carries a large, brown owl-shaped backpack. The street is lined with green hedges and white buildings, with a white SUV parked on the right under clear daylight. (2) Inside a brightly lit retail space filled with plush toys on wooden shelves, the woman stands looking at a blue-and-white striped dinosaur plush. She gestures with her hands, covers her mouth in hesitation, and points toward the shelves while speaking. (3) A close-up shot shows a hand holding the blue dinosaur plush in front of the woman. She looks at it, smiles slightly, but then shakes her head and looks away with a firm expression. (4) At a checkout counter, a male staff member in a purple uniform places items into a brown paper bag labeled "Natural History Museum." A hand reaches out to take the bag. (5) Outside, in front of a blue butterfly graphic wall, the woman holds the brown paper bag. She pulls out the blue dinosaur plush, looks at it with a joyful expression, and starts to nod her head. (6) The woman hugs the dinosaur plush tightly against her chest, looking up at the camera with a wide, happy smile. She then kisses the plush repeatedly as the camera zooms in slightly.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video documents a touching moment between a couple during a trip to London. It tells the story of the filmer's partner who liked a dinosaur plush at the museum but refused to buy it to save money. The filmer secretly purchases it to surprise her, demonstrating his affection. The core appeal lies in the genuine emotional reaction of the woman and the wholesome nature of the surprise.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: While the Natural History Museum and its merchandise are clearly featured, the video presents as a personal lifestyle vlog rather than a paid promotion.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses a classic 'boyfriend surprise' narrative arc popular in short-form content. The specific setting of the Natural History Museum in London adds a unique travel vlog element.
